animation.description: The animation that should be used when displaying and closing the banner.

primaryText.description: The primary text for the banner. It is bolded and can be up to 1 line in length.

secondaryText.description: The secondary text for the banner. It is not bolded and can be up to 2 lines in length.

bannerType.description: The style of the banner which determines both icon and color.

closeButtonEnabled.description: Whether or not to display the default close button.

messageId.description: A unique id given to every message by UiSdlMessageContainer. For internal use only.

componentId.description: The id of the UiSdlMessageContainer this message belongs to. For internal use only.

status.description: The status of the banner. For internal use only.

title:
A type defining the structure of a payload for {@link UiSdlMessageContainer#showBannerAction}.
It describes a message banner displayed {@link UiSdlMessageContainer}.
name: UiSdlMessageBannerConfig
